repository-level example project and executable end-to-end tests
explicitly_out_of_scope: calling any proprietary or hosted LLM API

blocking_invariants: no LLM response may be treated as promoted scientific authority by this runtime
canonical payload identity is SHA-256 over exact bytes
an existing content-addressed object whose bytes do not match its digest is an integrity failure, never silently overwritten
mandatory context cannot be dropped to satisfy a budget
unknown model capabilities produce CANNOT_CHECK rather than optimistic PASS
low context capacity produces INCOMPATIBLE rather than silently shrinking the required profile
record identifiers cannot create arbitrary filesystem paths
project initialization cannot rewrite an existing incompatible project
task packet includes explicit authority boundary and source digests
no protected evaluator, workflow, promotion, or pytest configuration is modified
